combo.description: To chase players down E forward then instantly Flash towards your target and AA. Cast Q W quickly with a final AA right after.
To juke opponents R then Flash mid animation, Q instantly when you land then AA and E to reposition. Follow up with AA W, and AA until your Q is off cooldown.
Begin your Q animation then instantly Flash to catch them off guard. Follow up with W and E to reposition.
While locked in your R animation you can Flash to create distance. E forward then instantly Q W and quickly AA and cast R but mid animation Flash away.
At the max range of W, R then use your W. Quickly E and Flash towards your target, then Q AA.
When in close range, AA Q then instantly W. E away from your target and cast R to create distance.
To snipe from distance, E towards your target then quickly Q W R right after one another
To fully burst someone R then quickly E forward, W and AA Q AA right after.
When slightly further away E forward then instantly Q AA. During the AA downtime W and continue to AA until your Q is back up.
Quickly trade with W then instantly E foward, Q and AA.
If you land a Q and want to all in. Q then E forward and AA. During the AA downtime use W so that your next AA procs it
